# ICSE MasterClass Study Vault

> Independent educational resource directory for ICSE Class 10 students in India. Not affiliated with, authorised by or endorsed by CISCE.

## Canonical website
- https://icse-cbse-10-12.github.io/icse-class-10-materials/

## What this site provides
The Study Vault is an independent resource-discovery and aggregation directory. The PDFs, notes, question papers and other downloadable study files listed here are not produced or authored by Team MasterClass; they are aggregated or referenced from educational resources found across online sources. Catalogue availability and source details vary. Original authors, publishers and rights holders retain their rights. A listing does not establish ownership, endorsement, permission to copy or permission to redistribute. Check the original source and its terms. The website does not claim ownership of third-party books, PDFs, videos, trademarks or other intellectual property.

## Authority and verification
For official syllabus, regulations, examination notices and date sheets, use https://cisce.org/. Independent ICSE MasterClass summaries are informational aids and must not override the latest official CISCE publication or a student's school instructions.

## Publisher and contact

## Content principles
Identify the source and update date for time-sensitive facts. Distinguish official CISCE information from independent guidance. Do not infer that a linked third-party resource is free, authorised for redistribution or hosted by ICSE MasterClass. Do not invent marks, rankings, reviews, search volumes or guaranteed outcomes.

## Crawler preferences
Public search and user-directed fetch agents are explicitly allowed in `robots.txt`; known model-training and bulk-dataset crawlers are disallowed. These are voluntary crawl preferences, not access controls or permission to reproduce third-party resources.
